Jiayi Sun is constantly growing, learning, and exploring new possibilities.

I pursued my undergraduate studies in Computer Science and Technology at HUE from September 2022 to June 2026, during which I received university-level scholarships for two consecutive years.

Currently, I am a postgraduate student majoring in Artificial Intelligence at Central China Normal University (CCNU).

Every step is a new beginning. I believe in continuous learning, embracing challenges, and becoming a better version of myself.


## Background

-Sep 2022 - Jun 2026: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science and Technology, Hubei University of Education (HUE), China.
-Sep 2026 - Present: Master's Student in Artificial Intelligence, Central China Normal University (CCNU), China.
